entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return something I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the order number, please?

Thank you, John. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on January 15th. To get this started, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It just isn't what I wanted. I honestly expected more.
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you tell me a little more about what you found disappointing?
Look, the whole interface is confusing. I even looked at the user manual, and it's still hard to use. It's not for me.
Okay, I understand. It sounds like it just wasn't the right fit. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, John, thanks for your patience. I see the delivery was only 7 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, so you're unfortunately outside that timeframe. I have approved the return for you.

I've just sent an email to the address on file. It contains a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. That usually takes 3-5 business days.
Whatever. I guess that's sorted, then.
Yes, it is. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
